declarations.description:
Small status label: a tinted pill with text, a number or an icon, or a plain dot. Six `tone`s carry meaning
(neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, info); each is a pair of CSS variables so a design system can recolour
them without touching the markup. Give it a `count` to show a number clamped at `max` (`99+`), or `dot` for a
presence indicator that can `pulse`. Put an element in the `anchor` slot and the badge pins itself to one of its
corners (`placement`), for example a notification count on an icon button; `overlap="circular"` moves it onto the
edge of a round anchor such as an avatar.
declarations.name: Badge

cssProperties.description: Space between the icon and the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--gap

cssProperties.description: Set a border for an outlined look, together with a transparent background.
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--border

cssProperties.description: Diameter of the `dot` badge; its colour is the tone text colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__dot--size

cssProperties.description: Length of one `pulse` cycle; respects reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__pulse--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Ring around an anchored badge, in the page background colour. Drawn outside a `dot`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__anchor--border

cssProperties.description: Moves an anchored badge inwards horizontally (`14.6%` with `overlap="circular"`).
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__anchor--offset-x

cssProperties.description: Moves an anchored badge inwards vertically (`14.6%` with `overlap="circular"`).
cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__anchor--offset-y

slots.description: Label text. Ignored while `count` or `dot` is set.
Icon shown before the text, sized by `--c2-badge__icon--size`.
slots.name: prefix-icon

slots.description: Element the badge is pinned to. When filled the badge becomes an overlay at the `placement` corner.
slots.name: anchor

members.name: count
members.description: Number to display instead of the slotted text. Hidden when it is `0` unless `show-zero` is set.

members.name: max
members.description: Upper bound for `count`; larger values render as `<max>+`.

members.name: dot
members.description: Renders a small dot without text.

members.name: pulse
members.description: Animates a fading ring around a `dot` badge to draw attention.

members.name: placement
members.description: Corner of the `anchor` element the badge is pinned to.

members.name: overlap
members.description: Shape of the anchor: `circular` pulls the badge onto the edge of a round anchor instead of its bounding-box corner.
